events.headline: Democrats swept the Nov. 3 US midterm elections, flipping both the House and Senate; futures and early trade showed AI/data-center and large-cap tech names falling on fears of a data-center cost/regulation crackdown, while healthcare stocks (e.g. UnitedHealth, HCA, Intuitive Surgical) were flagged as likely beneficiaries of a Democratic Congress

Reuters 'Wall St Week Ahead' (filed ahead of the midterms) reported the S&P 500 and Nasdaq had already sold off sharply (-1.8%/-2.9% in the prior session) on AI-capex doubts, with the midterm outcome seen as the next catalyst for AI-linked stocks

China's one-year suspension of its expanded October 2025 export controls on rare earths, rare-earth equipment and lithium-battery/graphite materials is set to expire Nov. 10, 2026, with no official word yet on whether Beijing will extend, narrow, or let the suspension lapse -- leaving a near-term supply overhang for materials names
